topics.title: My School
topics.description: Talk about your school and its facilities.
topics.prompt: Where is your school? What does it look like? What facilities does it have? What do you like most about your school?
topics.sample_answer: My school is in my neighbourhood. It is quite large and has many classrooms. There is also a library, a computer room and a big playground. My favourite place is the library because I can read books and study there. I love my school because my teachers and friends are very friendly.

topics.title: A Visit to Another School
topics.description: Describe a visit to another school.
topics.prompt: Have you ever visited another school? Where was it? What did you see there? What was different from your school?
topics.sample_answer: Last year, I visited another school with my classmates. The school was quite modern and had a large campus. I saw many classrooms, a science laboratory and a beautiful library. The facilities were different from those at my school. I enjoyed the visit because I learned more about another school's learning environment.

topics.title: My Ideal School
topics.description: Talk about the school you would like to study at.
topics.prompt: What would your ideal school look like? What facilities would it have? What activities could students do there? Why would you like to study there?
topics.sample_answer: My ideal school would be modern, clean and green. It would have large classrooms, a good library, a science laboratory and a sports centre. Students could join many clubs and take part in outdoor activities. I would also like to have more technology in classrooms. I think this school would be a great place to learn and make friends.
